data.one_liner: Search for Korean postal addresses using the Kakao postcode service via a WebView widget.
data.what_it_does: Kpostal provides a ready-made `KpostalView` widget that integrates the Kakao (Daum) postcode service. When pushed via navigator, it lets users search for Korean postal addresses and returns structured address data along with optional latitude and longitude coordinates.
use_when: You need Korean postal address lookup in your Flutter app.
You want built-in geocoding support alongside address searching.
avoid_when: You are building for Windows or Linux, which are not supported.
You require an address lookup service outside of Korea.
strengths: Zero configuration needed by default for Android and iOS using the hosted search page.
Supports Android, iOS, macOS, and Web.
Built-in geocoding support via platform services and Kakao Maps API.
weaknesses: Does not support Windows and Linux platforms.
Web platform requires Kakao API keys for geocoding since platform geocoding is unavailable there.
data.setup_notes: Android may require internet permission in release mode. macOS requires network client entitlements. Optional local server or Kakao geocoding configurations are documented.
data.minimal_example:
Kpostal result = await Navigator.push(
  context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => KpostalView()));
